sections.title: Your business

questions.text: What projects are you running now, and what stage is each one at?
questions.hint: For example: a new home in framing, or a kitchen renovation starting next month.

questions.text: Who currently prepares material lists, chooses suppliers and places orders?
questions.hint: Tell us the roles involved. Names are optional.

sections.description: A little context helps us ask better follow-up questions.

sections.title: One recent order

questions.text: Describe your most recent material order, from making the list to delivery.
questions.hint: What did you order, how did you find it, and how did it arrive? A few sentences are enough.

questions.text: Which part took the most effort or did not go as expected?
questions.hint: For example: comparing quotes, tracking delivery, missing items, or repeated phone calls.

questions.text: Roughly how much of your time did that order take, and who did you have to contact?
questions.hint: An estimate is fine. You can leave this blank if you are not sure.

sections.description: Think about one real order, rather than how orders usually work.

sections.title: Where work repeats

questions.text: Which one or two material packages cause the most repeated work for you?
questions.hint: For example: lumber, windows, roofing, plumbing, electrical, or finishes.

questions.text: How often does that happen, and what does it affect when it does?
questions.hint: For example: twice a week; delays the crew; interrupts other work.

questions.text: What have you tried to make this easier, and what still falls back on you?
questions.hint: What helped, and what did not?

sections.description: Tell us where you spend time repeatedly.

sections.title: How you want to work

questions.text: Who should confirm quantities and specifications, approve spending, and check the delivery on site?
questions.hint: Tell us which decisions you want to keep and who receives deliveries.

questions.text: When your sub needs materials, how would you want the request and approval to reach us?
questions.hint: For example: the trade sends you a list, and you approve it before ordering.

questions.text: What would you hand over, and what would you prefer to keep handling yourself?
questions.hint: Describe your preferred responsibilities. This does not authorize any purchase.

sections.description: Let us know what you would keep and what you might hand over.

sections.title: Your priorities

questions.text: If we could take only one or two recurring tasks off your plate, which would you choose?
questions.hint: Choose the one or two things that would make the biggest difference.

questions.text: What would make the first order feel successful enough to use us again?
questions.hint: For example: fewer calls, a clear comparison, or delivery when the crew needs it.

sections.description: Focus on the help that would matter most to you.

sections.title: Review & next step

questions.text: Is there anything else you would like us to know?
questions.hint: Anything else we should understand about your projects or preferred way of working?

questions.text: What upcoming order or project would you like help with first?
questions.hint: Tell us about an upcoming order, timing, or what you would like to discuss first.

sections.description: Add your next step, then check your answers before sending.
